outlook.statement: It is expected that the Company will sustain its profits in the future years.

Real GDP growth for 2026-27 is projected at 6.9 per cent. Government's focus on scaling up domestic manufacturing in several strategic and frontier sectors announced in the Union Budget 2026-27, GST rationalization, promises well for India's maintaining the growth trajectory.
The company manages its capital to ensure that it will be able to continue as going concern while maximising the return to stakeholders through the optimisation of the debt and equity balance.
